City of San Jose permit H26-007 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Site Development Permit to allow the construction of five buildings consisting of 18 townhome units and the removal of 20 trees (16 ordinance-size and four non-ordinance-size) on an approximately 0.99-gross-acre site"

City of San Jose permit T25-025 (Tentative Map, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Vesting Tentative Map to allow the subdivision of one lot into five lots for residential purposes, with these lots further subdivided for condominium purposes for up to 18 condominium units across all lots on an approximately 0.99-gross-acre site"

CEQAnet: General Plan Amendment from Neighborhood/Community Commercial to Mixed-Use Neighborhood and rezoning (present zoning A(PD)) for 18 townhomes in five buildings on a 0.99-gross-acre vacant site at The Alameda and Emory Street; two full-access driveways on Emory Street. Applicant listed as Dan Mountsier, Emory Holding LLC, Campbell.

SF YIMBY: site vacant since 1965 per the Initial Study; 7,400 sq ft of common open space including a private paseo; construction estimated at about 18 months. Names Dan Mountsier of Pinion Property Company as applicant.
